project_type: Static client-side web app (SPA-like, single index.html) for employee evaluation. No server code. Firebase (compat SDK) optional backend; falls back to localStorage.
language: Vanilla JavaScript (ES5/ES2017-ish, IIFE pattern), HTML, CSS. No TypeScript.
build_system: NONE. No build step, no npm, no bundler, no ES modules. Scripts are loaded via plain <script> tags in index.html in this order: firebase-config.js, js/store.js, js/model.js, js/app.js. Libraries come via CDN: Chart.js 4.4.1 (cdn.jsdelivr.net) and Firebase compat 10.12.2 (gstatic.com). Each JS file is an IIFE that assigns to a window global (window.Store, window.Model); app.js has no global export, it just runs. DO NOT introduce import/export, bundlers, or package.json.
test_framework: NONE. No test runner exists. Verification is manual via a static file server plus in-browser console.assert self-tests added by this task.
build_command: No build. To serve: caddy file-server --listen :8080 --root c:\dev\avaliacao\.worktrees\trimestral
test_command: Open http://localhost:8080 in a browser; check DevTools console for errors. Open http://localhost:8080/?selftest to run the console.assert self-tests. caddy.exe is installed at C:\Users\lcalmeida4\AppData\Local (on PATH as 'caddy').
verification_instructions: 1) Start caddy as above (serves the worktree root). 2) Load http://localhost:8080 — in local mode (no real Firebase config) the app auto-logs in as a local leader. 3) Confirm no console SyntaxError/ReferenceError on load (balanced braces/parens/backticks). 4) Confirm index.html exposes the new view: nav-item data-view='evolution' and section id='view-evolution'. 5) Migration check: a LEGACY member ({scores,plan} at root, no periods) must read as periods[currentQuarter] with identical data; a NEW member (already has periods) is unchanged. 6) After saving a migrated member, the stored doc (inspect localStorage['avaliacao.members.v1'] in local mode) must have periods[...] and NO root scores/plan. 7) Switching quarters and returning preserves data. 8) http://localhost:8080/?selftest — all console.assert pass (no 'Assertion failed'). 9) Regression: login, roles, Usuários (with its delete button), and Tutorial still work.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. caddy is the only available static server (no Node/Python). Do NOT modify firebase-config.js or firestore.rules. The app runs in LOCAL mode here (firebase-config.js has placeholders), so LocalStore (role 'leader', data in localStorage key 'avaliacao.members.v1') is the active path — but all store changes MUST be mirrored in both LocalStore and the Firebase store so Firebase deployments stay correct. In Firebase mode, Store.save uses col.doc(id).set(member, { merge: true }), so stale root fields must be removed explicitly with firebase.firestore.FieldValue.delete().
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. README documents the structure and that business rules live in js/model.js (PILLARS, PERFORMANCE_WEIGHTS, POTENTIAL_WEIGHTS). Follow existing code conventions: Portuguese comments, IIFE modules, window globals, 2-space indent, descriptive comments explaining business/migration logic. Commit locally on branch feat/avaliacao-trimestral; never push.
key_patterns: Data model: each 'members' doc = { id (=normalized email), email, name, role (job-title text), scores, plan }. scores = { [pillarId]: { [competencyName]: 1..5 } }. plan = [ { id, title, desc, tasks:[{id,text,done}] } ]. Pillars have ids hard/soft/discipline (Model.PILLARS). The app keeps members in an in-memory array (app.js 'members'), re-reads via Store.list(), re-renders via reloadAndRender(). canEdit() === Store.isLeader() gates all editing; collaborators are read-only. switchView(view) toggles .nav-item.active and .view.active and calls the matching render function. Charts (radarCharts map, nineBoxChart) are destroyed before re-draw. periodKey format decided for this task: 'YYYY-Qn' (Q1 Jan-Mar ... Q4 Oct-Dec), current = year + '-Q' + (Math.floor(new Date().getMonth()/3)+1).
